This place has terrible customer service. They advertise a "lifetime warranty," but what they don't clearly explain is that you must bring your truck in every six months and pay approximately $350 to keep that warranty active.
Make sure you carefully read all of the paperwork they give you. There are additional requirements and deadlines that can void the warranty if they are not followed. For example, you may be required to bring the vehicle back within a certain timeframe after repairs, or the warranty can become invalid.
The most frustrating part is that I still can't get help with my ongoing issue. I've spent money, followed their instructions, and I'm still dealing with the same problem without a proper resolution.
Based on my experience, I would not recommend this shop

This company appears to remove negative reviews rather than resolve customer issues. The customer service has been unacceptable, and what is advertised is not what customers actually receive. Transparency and accountability matter, and potential customers should carefully review all paperwork and warranty terms before doing business here.

If you’re posting a public review, it’s best to focus on the specific facts of your experience (what happened, what was promised, what you were charged, and how the issue was handled). That makes the review more credible and less likely to be removed

I would not recommend this shop. They continue charging us for repairs, yet the original problem has still not been fixed.

I have repeatedly asked to speak with the owner, but have been unable to do so. The receptionist has been rude and has provided inaccurate information about the work being performed, despite not appearing to have full knowledge of the repairs.

My truck is still not fixed. We were told the transmission had been repaired, but when my father inspected it, a piece of tape he had previously placed on a transmission component was still there, indicating that the repair may not have been completed as claimed.

I also encourage customers to carefully review the warranty paperwork. The "lifetime warranty" requires bringing the vehicle in every six months and paying approximately $350. In addition, the warranty appears to cover labor only and not the actual parts.

If anyone has the owner's contact information, or if the owner sees this post, I would appreciate being contacted to discuss this matter directly.

I brought my car in to get some custom body work done to make the rear quarter panels wider. At first I was promised a 2 week turnaround and I agreed. After a week I received a call asking for more money to get the job done which I was okay with but that was the only time they called me. It took them over a month to get the job done. The last week I called, according to them, the car had to be repainted 3 times because it wasn't up to their standards. After being told it was ready I went to pick it up and I was made to wait 2 more hours as they were still putting it together. When I finally got my car back the work wasn't anywhere near perfect so I have a hard time understanding why it took over a month. Paint drips, Fish eye, over spray, paint chipping off, body panels not staying in place, and a huge bubble formed underneath the paint the next day. I called to explained my concerns and they told me to wait a few weeks and it'll fix itself. I waited and as I had expected, they problem did not correct itself. I took it back and they agreed to fix it. Again, the turnaround time of a week was not met and on the second week when I called I was told it was ready. They did fix a couple things but completely ignored others and made some worse. Now there is trash in the paint. I don't even know how they managed to get clear coat on my key fob. Now I'm having to pay another body shop to fix the paint job on my car and do the job correctly. I do not recommend this place. Poor quality work and poor communication.

I’m going to make this as short as possible. I went here because I saw they worked on another 370 and saw they had good reviews. I had them install a wing and two front carbon fiber fenders. They originally told me two weeks. After a few phone calls, it was ready 5 weeks later. When I went to pick it up, they did nothing to try and make the fenders fit correctly. I had chipped paint in multiple locations near the fender and the door. My driver side headlight has a very deep scratch which I don’t even know how that happened. When I picked it up it was in a dim warehouse so I didn’t see all the imperfections till I got home and looked at it in the sun. Now I’m having to go to another shop to fix what they did. Don’t go here if you’re having any bodywork done or care about your car. It really sucks when you get your car back in worse shape than when you dropped it off. There’s also a gap on the wing and they used silicone glue to glue it to my trunk which I was never told about or I would have said don’t do it. I was also told it was going to be 200 more and they didn’t even do all the work. I had to call the owner and tell him all the work we agreed to wasn’t done and I wasn’t going to pay more. Go somewhere else!

I didn't want to get jerked around at a dealership so I took my car to this place after reading such fantastic reviews. First impression was that it was a nice family run shop with dad(Joe) and his daughter (Amanda) running the place.

They were quite busy and I was advised to leave my car with them. Before leaving, I had a conversation with Amanda and explicitly discussed about no fees, or work done on the car without my permission first. She agreed, so off I went. When I came back a couple hours later, Joe found a list of problems with my car. I was advised that my EGR valve needed to be completely replaced and alignment had issues and my wheel bearings needed to be replaced as one side was pretty badly damaged. Price was quoted to me in the thousands and I thought OK, fair enough for all the parts and labor but the wait time was too long and they wouldn't be able to see my car until 3-4 days later. I had to decline because I needed to be back on the road in 2 days and decided that I would come back another time to at least have the bearings replaced as they mentioned it was very worn out. Amanda was not too sure on how to give me an explanation and Joe had just left the office, so we called Joe to check with him to see if the noise wasn't anything else. To my surprise & confusion, Joe steered the conversation into me owing them money since they had to test my car 3 times with 2 different mechanics listening for noises. I surely did not ask for them to test it 3 times with multiple mechanics...otherwise it would have been free to run a check engine light check. Because Joe made his case so strongly, Amanda backed him up and stood by his decision to charge me, even though we discussed that this wouldn't happen. They did mention that if I came back and got the work done with them, this fee I pay now would go towards the cost of repairs when I bring it in next time. Not exactly what was agreed, but I didn't want to make things ugly over a $100 dollar fee. At this point, I intended to come back later to get the wheel work done.

Since I needed to be back on the road, I took my car to the VW dealership and they did a engine light check and found a loose clamp that was causing the noise and low pressure on the EGR valve. The clamp is a $10 dollar part that came loose and caused engine noise. The dealership told me it was quite obvious and they spotted it right away. I also told them that Fix Euro mechanic told me the wheel bearing had some damage and they said they checked and NOTHING needs to be replaced, just get a wheel alignment to prevent uneven tire tread.

After the dealership told me all this, you can see why I am writing this long-winded review out of my disgust for what transpired at Fix Euro. They asked me to pay in the thousands to replace parts that the dealership told me were COMPLETELY FINE!!!!!!! The VW dealership had me back on the road after tightening the clamp that came loose at no cost. I am sure other people had good experiences with them, but this was absolutely a bad experience for me.
